name: glm-sc410-tp2-longctx-mtp
_comment: Portable configuration example: host, user and private workspace paths are placeholders, not original measured infrastructure. Historical context follows; this is not a new qualification claim. The sc_4.10bpw pack at TP=2 (N3 rank 0, N2 rank 1) with a 131,072-token window, 2 slots, 262,144 KV tokens, with the pack's NextN layer drafting (--spec auto): the LONG-CONTEXT kit of PASS_RULES_GLM_ADDENDUM_GEOMETRY D-G1 (the whole-window request drafted and with "draft": false), frozen in PASS_RULES_GLM_ADDENDUM_LONGCTX (D-L1, D-L2, D-L5). The rank planner grants these flags from 99.125 GiB free on either rank (tp_boot::tests::the_sc410_long_context_kit_plans_from_its_share); 1.6 GiB of margin, rounded up. Every other block (nodes, nccl with lib, pack, binary, tp, supervisor, user) is cluster.glm-sc410-tp2-mtp.json's, verbatim.
